name: Horizon Bands
description: Three broad color bands stacked like a horizon line, with a small sun that drifts across on its own timer.

code.style: --rule: ( background: linear-gradient(@pick-d(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg), var(--color1) 25%, var(--color2) 25% 50%, var(--color3) 50%); :after { content: ''; width: @r(20%, 50%); aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at @r(100%) @r(100%), var(--color4) 0% 50%, var(--color5) 50% 100%); display: none; transform: translateX(@r(-30%, -60%)); animation: floatAnim @r(1s, 1.5s) @r(1.5s) infinite alternate ease-in-out; } @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { display: unset; } } @keyframes floatAnim { 100% { transform: translateX(@r(30%, 60%)); } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
